title: 1990 Topps #457 Gregg Jefferies New York Mets Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1990 Topps baseball card features Gregg Jefferies of the New York Mets. With a standard size and card number 457, this sports trading card is a part of the base set. Manufactured by Topps in 1990, it is a great addition for collectors of Major League Baseball (MLB) memorabilia. The card showcases Jefferies in his prime and is a must-have for any avid fan of the sport. Whether you are a collector or just looking to add a unique piece to your collection, this card is a great choice.
